description: This file provides French localization strings for the Select2 JavaScript plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1;

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message indicating results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating how many characters to remove when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating the number of characters to add when input is shorter than minimum.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating the maximum number of selectable elements.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message indicating that a search is in progress.
